title: Cost-Per-Verified-Success KPI — M4a (Cohort Freeze Mechanism)
scope_note: M4a = the cohort-FREEZE MECHANISM only (write side). M1-M3 landed 2026-07-27 (9bdc9319c, 2a2a40f31, 2d76b2cc3, merged d869ec12d) and must NOT be re-planned. Zero benchmark executions and zero metered spend in this sprint.

out_of_scope.out_of_scope_M4b: Actually RUNNING the baseline cohort and publishing the measured number. Real metered exposure on the OpenRouter lanes; parked on the human's spend approval. HARD-BLOCKED by blocking finding BF-1 until that is closed.
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_provenance: ClassifyStageCost (internal/observatory/cost_classify.go rule 1) treats any stage.Cost > 0 as authoritative CostStatusReported, but the SUBSCRIPTION claude CLI reports a non-zero total_cost_usd when nothing is billed (live-probed: 10 in / 46 out tokens -> total_cost_usd 0.0108355 with both Anthropic API keys stripped). On this rig ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is absent, so every claude agent run is subscription and its cost is a LIST-PRICE EQUIVALENT, not a metered dollar. The doc's Primary Goal says 'metered'. A cohort spanning claude (notional) + OpenRouter (real) blends both under one 'reported' label. DO NOT design a fix — open product decision. M4a's only obligation is not to hide it (the manifest records the resolved executor per model) plus a docs caveat.
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_hash_enforcement: Strict-mode COMPARISON of the recorded cohort_hash against the queried cohort. Needs the manifest reachable from the DB (execution_chains has no metadata column -> migration). The hash is RECORDED here; enforcing it is a follow-up.
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_db_manifest: A cohort_manifest column on execution_chains. Schema migration; the manifest file + source_ref pair is sufficient release evidence for M4a.
out_of_scope.out_of_scope_placement: Mark's primary-landing-surface mirror for the KPI card (still Mark-gated from the M1-M3 sprint).

blocking_findings.premise_contradicted: Handed-down fact 2 stated agent-mode verification 'is already wired (agent_runner.go:316 + agent_runner_multi.go)'. The agent_runner_multi.go half is FALSE and the agent_runner.go half is on a DEAD path.
blocking_findings.evidence: The only agent-mode RunAICheck is internal/eval_harness/agent_runner.go:316-317, inside RunAgentBenchmark() (agent_runner.go:195), which has NO caller — `grep -rn 'RunAgentBenchmark(' --include=*.go .` returns only its definition plus the comment at cmd/ailang/eval_benchmark.go:129 ('Always use multi-executor runner -- legacy RunAgentBenchmark() hardcodes Claude and must NOT be used'). The live path is RunAgentBenchmarkWithExecutor (eval_benchmark.go:179 -> agent_runner_multi.go:76); `grep -n Verify internal/eval_harness/agent_runner_multi.go` = ZERO matches. Live RunAICheck sites: repair.go:76 (STANDARD mode only) and the dead agent_runner.go:317.
blocking_findings.consequence: Even with the freeze mechanism landed and a --verify --agent cohort run executed, every banked eval_assessment carries an all-zero verify block. isVerifiedSuccess (cost_per_verified_success.go:95-105) requires VerifyVerified > 0, so VerifiedSuccesses == 0 and the KPI returns available:false reason:zero_denominator FOREVER. Also explains why no banked run has ever had verify_verified > 0 — a harness gap, not lack of opportunity.
blocking_findings.handling: Carried as CONDITIONAL milestone M4a-3 (move + delete, per CLAUDE.md systemic-fix rule: one gap, two manifestations). Severable — does not gate M4a-1/2/4. If cut, M4b spend must stay blocked.

blocking_findings.finding: The baseline id is used as an unescaped SQL LIKE pattern: store_chains_eval.go:96-97 builds `c.source_ref LIKE ?` with SourceRefPrefix+'%' and no ESCAPE clause. SQLite LIKE treats '_' as a single-char wildcard, so a baseline id containing '_' or '%' silently widens the cohort (e.g. 'v1_0' also matches 'v1x0/...').
blocking_findings.handling: M4a introduces the write side, which is where the charset must be pinned. Validate at freeze time (^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9.-]*$) and reuse the SAME validator on the read side (chains_stats_cvs.go).

blocking_findings.finding: --verify-timeout is ignored on the agent path. eval_suite.go:182 sets evalVerifyTimeout, which reaches only repairRunner.SetVerify (eval.go:166, eval_benchmark.go:561) = standard mode. The agent call hardcodes 5*time.Second (agent_runner.go:317).
blocking_findings.handling: Fold the plumbing in IFF M4a-3 is executed (one parameter on the moved block); otherwise record as a manifest caveat, since the manifest claims to record verify_timeout.

milestones.name: Recorded, data-driven cohort manifest
milestones.description: Write <outputDir>/cohort_manifest.json (only when --baseline is set) recording baseline_id, source_ref_prefix, frozen_at, run_window{started_at,completed_at}, eval_mode, languages, conditions, model_suite, models[] (RESOLVED via expandModelSuite -> GetAgentSuite, never hardcoded in Go), executors[] per model (GetExecutorForModel — also the out_of_scope_provenance audit hook), benchmarks[] (resolved post-discovery/post---tier), seed, prompt_version, trials, verify, verify_timeout, ailang_version, git_commit, chain_id, and a cohort_hash. Re-freezable per Mark's 2026-07-27 ratification: nothing in Go names a model, so a models.yml edit yields a new manifest and a DIFFERENT cohort_hash (visible drift, not silent), and a re-freeze publishes as a NEW baseline id rather than rewriting a published one. completed_at is filled in by finalizeSuiteRun via a new cohortManifestPath field on suiteSummaryParams.

--baseline v1.0 -> <outputDir>/cohort_manifest.json exists, parses, and carries every planned field

models[] equals GetAgentSuite() from models.yml for --models agent_suite; the test READS models.yml instead of pinning a literal 6-name list (a suite edit must not fail the test but must change the manifest)
model_suite records "agent_suite"; an explicit comma list records "" with the same resolved members
cohort_hash is stable across builds, order-independent for models/benchmarks, and CHANGES when a model or benchmark is added/removed
